items.title: Extension of algebraically closed fields does not change the kernel of the Frobenius linear map minus one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is stated inside the situation of the preceding Frobenius linear lemma and asserts that extending the algebraically closed base field does not change the kernel of F - 1 (statement lines 9691-9697). The proof writes the kernel out in coordinates: after choosing a basis the condition becomes a system of Frobenius-linear equations (proof lines 9700-9703), which by the companion lemma cut out a closed subscheme of affine space finite over Spec(k) (proof lines 9703-9705); the conclusion then follows from the equality of the point sets over k and over k' (proof lines 9705-9706). The non-formal content is the coordinate description and its interpretation as a finite closed subscheme. The claim is H1: one coordinate computation fed into a named companion result.
